overall: At 02:50 ET, Atlanta is sitting at a very warm 71.6°F with a running max of 72.0°F — an unusually mild early-morning floor driven by a high dewpoint of 66.2°F, indicating a moist, humid airmass in place. Moderate confidence in ~81°F as the best single estimate, with meaningful downside risk toward 80°F if moisture-driven cloud cover develops mid-afternoon.
